title: AtManRL: Towards Faithful Reasoning via Differentiable Attention Saliency
abstract: arXiv:2604.16158v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex tasks, yet a reasoning trace may merely accompany the final answer rather than causally contribute to it or faithfully reflect how it was reached. We introduce differentiable attention manipulation to train salient reasoning with reinforcement learning -- method which we call AtManRL. By optimizing an additive attention mask that identifies the CoT tokens needed to recover the model's answer, we derive a saliency reward and combine it with an outcome reward in GRPO with decoupled advantages. Because both saliency and faithfulness depend strongly on trace length, we evaluate against a sweep of length-penalty baselines that traces the trade-off a pure length penalty can reach, rather than against a single baseline. Across three models (Qwen2.5-3B, Granite-3.3-2B, and Phi-4-mini) and four benchmarks (GSM8K, MMLU, ProofWriter, and QuestBen

translated_title: AtManRL：通过可微注意力显著性迈向忠实推理
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）日益依赖思维链推理来解决复杂任务，然而推理轨迹可能只是伴随最终答案出现，而非因果性地促成答案，或忠实地反映答案的得出过程。我们引入可微注意力操作，通过强化学习训练显著性推理，并将该方法命名为 AtManRL。通过优化一个加性注意力掩码来识别恢复模型答案所需的思维链标记，我们推导出显著性奖励，并将其与结果奖励相结合，应用于具有解耦优势的 GRPO 中。由于显著性和忠实性都强烈依赖于轨迹长度，我们在评估时针对一系列长度惩罚基线进行扫描，以追踪纯长度惩罚所能达到的权衡范围，而非仅与单一基线比较。在三个模型和四个基准测试上的实验表明了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出AtManRL方法，通过优化可微注意力掩码推导显著性奖励并与结果奖励结合于GRPO强化学习框架中，使思维链推理真正因果性地促成最终答案，从而提升推理的忠实性。
en_tdlr: AtManRL introduces differentiable attention manipulation to derive a saliency reward combined with outcome reward in GRPO, training chain-of-thought reasoning that causally contributes to and faithfully reflects the final answer.
